text: I won't let you get to the Champion's Coin.
zh: 我不会让你染指冠军硬币。

text: As long as my pain-wracked body moves, I will prevent you from obtaining the coin.
zh: 只要我这具饱受痛苦折磨的身躯还能动弹，我就会阻止你得到那枚硬币。

text: You may have defeated the former guard of the High Council, but against my godlike power, you are nothing.
zh: 你或许击败了高等议会昔日的守卫，但在我神一般的力量面前，你什么都不是。
